summary.headline: Top frustrations with e-bikes: batteries dying mid-ride, slow or refused repairs, and bikes too heavy to ride or carry without power.
summary.text: Across 73 genuine posts (from 205 pulled), battery problems dominate once combined: 12 posts about dying mid-ride, 6 about $600–950 replacement packs and 3 about fire risk. Another 10 describe repair waits of weeks to months or shops that won't touch e-bikes, so service and parts availability may matter as much as the bike itself.
